## [1.1.1](https://github.com/pablobaro/pablobaro-morphe-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.1.1) (2026-11-06)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **spotify:** make "Change package name" opt-in ([172cff4](https://github.com/pablobaro/pablobaro-morphe-patches/commit/172cff4a0f426226d2a3f28d910390a5176830b9))

patches.name: Block popup ads
patches.description: Blocks fullscreen promotions ("Pendragon" messages) shown when opening the app.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Changes the package name and app name so the patched app can be installed alongside the original Spotify app.

options.description: The package name of the patched app. It must differ from the original one.
The name shown in the launcher.

patches.name: Diagnose Spotify client
patches.description: Logs signing-certificate queries and integrity-request outcomes without changing them. Does not log authentication tokens or account data. Experimental diagnostic, not a playback fix.

patches.name: Disable ad breaks
patches.description: Disables the ad slots that play ads between songs. Experimental.

patches.name: Fix third party launchers widgets
patches.description: Allows the Spotify widgets to be added to third party launchers.

patches.name: Hide Premium tab
patches.description: Removes the "Premium" tab from the bottom navigation bar.

patches.name: Hide ad sections
patches.description: Removes brand ad sections from the home and search page.

patches.name: Hide ad views
patches.description: Hides ad banners, display ads and the ad player. (Only works on older Spotify versions.)

patches.name: Hide context menu upsells
patches.description: Removes "Premium" entries from the context menus of songs, albums and playlists. (Only works on older Spotify versions.)

patches.name: Hide video ads
patches.description: Disables the video ad plugin of the now playing view.

patches.name: Mute audio ads
patches.description: Mutes the music stream while an audio ad plays and restores the volume afterwards. Enabling "Device broadcast status" in the Spotify settings improves the ad detection.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes the tracking parameters (si, utm_source) from shared and copied links.
